name: Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls
certifications: Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Professional
Palo Alto Networks Certified Next-Generation Firewall Engineer (replaced PCNSE, which retired in July 2025)

beginner.summary: For network and security engineers who are starting with Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls. Covers single-pass architecture with App-ID, User-ID and Content-ID, a VM-Series lab, initial configuration, interfaces and zones, logical routers, security and NAT policies, App-ID and Policy Optimizer, User-ID with the Cloud Identity Engine, security profiles, Advanced URL Filtering, WildFire and Advanced Threat Prevention, DNS Security, decryption, GlobalProtect, site-to-site VPNs, logging, high availability and traffic troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Understands IP addressing, routing and TCP and UDP ports
Has configured a router, switch or firewall before
outcomes: Configure interfaces, zones, routing, security and NAT policies on PAN-OS
Control applications, users and content with App-ID, User-ID and security profiles
Set up decryption, GlobalProtect and site-to-site VPNs
Monitor, run high availability and troubleshoot traffic

days.topic: Palo Alto NGFW Overview: Single-Pass Architecture, App-ID, User-ID and Content-ID
subtopics: Hardware, virtual, container and cloud firewalls
Management with Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager
Packet flow at a high level
Certifications: Network Security Professional and NGFW Engineer
Course project overview: a branch office and a head office
days.lab_task: Tour a PAN-OS firewall's dashboard, monitor tab and policies, trace one session in the traffic log and draw how App-ID, User-ID and Content-ID act on it.
days.deliverable: Annotated packet flow for one session
checks: One session is found in the traffic log
Each identification step is shown on the flow
Firewall form factors are matched to course sites

days.topic: Lab Setup: VM-Series Firewall, Management Access and Licences
subtopics: Deploying a VM-Series firewall in a lab
Lab topology with inside, outside and DMZ networks
days.lab_task: Deploy a VM-Series firewall, secure the admin account, license it, install content updates, build the lab topology and save a named configuration snapshot.
days.deliverable: Licensed lab firewall with a saved snapshot
checks: The firewall is reachable on its management interface with new credentials
Licences and content updates are active

days.topic: Initial Configuration: Management Settings, DNS, NTP and Updates
subtopics: Management interface services and permitted IPs
days.lab_task: Configure DNS, NTP, service routes and scheduled updates, restrict management access to an admin subnet and create a read-only admin role.
checks: The firewall keeps correct time and resolves names
Management access works only from the admin subnet

days.topic: Interfaces and Zones: Layer 3, Layer 2, Virtual Wire and Tap
days.lab_task: Configure inside, outside and DMZ zones on Layer 3 interfaces, add a VLAN subinterface, place a virtual wire pair in front of a test network and allow ping only where needed.
days.deliverable: Interfaces and zones for the lab
checks: Each interface belongs to the right zone
Ping works only on interfaces with the profile

days.topic: Logical Routers: Static Routes, Route Tables and Dynamic Routing
subtopics: Legacy virtual routers and the advanced routing engine
days.lab_task: Add static routes with path monitoring, run OSPF with the inside router and BGP with the outside router, and check routes in the forwarding table.
checks: Static routes fail over with path monitoring
OSPF and BGP neighbours are up
The forwarding table shows the expected next hops

days.topic: Security Policies: Rule Order, Zones, Applications and Services
subtopics: Testing policies with the policy match tool
days.lab_task: Write rules that let inside users browse with application-default, let the DMZ web server receive web traffic and block everything else, then test them with the policy match tool.
checks: Permitted traffic matches the intended rules
Other traffic hits the deny rule
Policy match tests return the expected rules

days.topic: App-ID in Practice: Application Signatures, Dependencies and Policy Optimizer
subtopics: Moving from port-based to application-based rules
days.lab_task: Convert two port-based rules to App-ID rules with Policy Optimizer, add dependencies, write a custom application for an internal app and review unknown traffic.
days.deliverable: Application-based rules and a custom application
checks: Port-based rules become application rules with no outage
The internal app is identified by the custom App-ID

days.topic: NAT Policies: Source NAT, Destination NAT and U-Turn NAT
subtopics: Dynamic IP and port source NAT
days.lab_task: Configure source NAT for inside users, destination NAT for the DMZ web server and U-turn NAT so inside users can reach it by its public address.
checks: Inside users reach the internet through source NAT
The web server is reachable from outside
Inside users reach the server by its public address

days.topic: User-ID: Group Mapping, Cloud Identity Engine and Authentication Policy
subtopics: User-ID sources: agents, syslog and APIs
days.lab_task: Map users from the directory through the Cloud Identity Engine, write rules for two groups and require MFA for access to the finance app.
checks: Users and groups appear on the firewall
Group rules allow only the right users

days.topic: Content-ID: Antivirus, Anti-Spyware, Vulnerability Protection and Security Profiles
days.lab_task: Build a best-practice profile group, apply it to internet rules and trigger test threats such as the EICAR file and a test exploit to see them blocked.
days.deliverable: Profile group with threat test results
checks: Internet rules use the profile group
A blocked file type cannot be uploaded

days.topic: URL Filtering and Advanced URL Filtering
days.lab_task: Block risky categories, add a custom allow list, stop users submitting corporate credentials to unknown sites and check the URL logs.
checks: The custom list overrides a category
Credential submission to unknown sites is blocked

days.topic: WildFire and Advanced Threat Prevention
subtopics: Advanced Threat Prevention for command and control
days.lab_task: Turn on WildFire forwarding and inline machine learning, submit a test file, review its verdict and block a simulated command-and-control connection.
checks: The test file is analysed with a verdict
The simulated command-and-control traffic is blocked
Inline machine learning is active on the profiles

days.topic: DNS Security and Sinkholing
subtopics: Finding infected hosts from sinkhole traffic
days.lab_task: Enable DNS Security with sinkholing, resolve a test malicious domain and use the sinkhole traffic to find the infected host.
days.deliverable: DNS security setup with an infected host found
checks: The malicious domain resolves to the sinkhole

days.topic: SSL/TLS Decryption: Forward Proxy, Inbound Inspection and Exclusions
subtopics: Decryption exclusions for privacy and pinned apps
days.lab_task: Decrypt outbound web traffic with a trusted forward proxy certificate, exclude banking and health sites, inspect inbound traffic to the DMZ server and review the decryption log.
checks: Outbound sessions are decrypted and inspected
Inbound traffic to the server is inspected

days.topic: GlobalProtect Remote Access VPN
days.lab_task: Set up a GlobalProtect portal and gateway with MFA, split tunnelling for SaaS and a HIP check that requires disk encryption, then connect a test laptop.
checks: The test laptop connects with MFA
SaaS traffic leaves directly while internal traffic uses the tunnel
A device without encryption is restricted

days.topic: Site-to-Site IPsec VPNs
days.lab_task: Build an IPsec tunnel from the branch to the head office firewall, route traffic through it, add tunnel monitoring and fix a seeded crypto mismatch.
checks: IKE and IPsec security associations are up
The crypto mismatch is found and fixed

days.topic: Logging, Monitoring and Reports: Traffic, Threat and Unified Logs
days.lab_task: Filter logs to answer three questions about a user, build a weekly custom report and forward threat logs to a syslog server.
days.deliverable: Saved filters, a report and log forwarding
checks: Threat logs reach the syslog server

days.topic: High Availability: Active/Passive Pairs and Failover
days.lab_task: Build an active/passive pair, sync configuration and sessions, add link monitoring, fail over during a file download and confirm the session survives.
days.deliverable: Working HA pair with a failover test
checks: Configuration and sessions sync between peers

days.topic: Troubleshooting Traffic: Packet Captures, Session Browser and CLI
subtopics: Traffic logs and session end reasons
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, a wrong rule order, a NAT error, a routing gap and an App-ID block, with captures and counters, fix them and record the steps.
checks: Captures or counters back each diagnosis

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Secure Internet Edge for a Branch Office
subtopics: Application and user rules with profiles
VPN to head office, HA and logging
days.lab_task: Deliver a secure internet edge for the branch with zones, routing, NAT, App-ID and User-ID rules with profiles, decryption, GlobalProtect, a VPN to head office, an HA pair and log forwarding.
days.deliverable: Working branch edge with a demo
checks: Test threats are blocked on every path
Remote users and the branch reach head office
The edge keeps working after a failover

intermediate.summary: For firewall administrators and engineers who run several Palo Alto firewalls, aligned with the NGFW Engineer certification. Covers Panorama device groups and templates, Strata Cloud Manager, rulebase design at scale, advanced routing and policy-based forwarding, decryption at scale, Zero Trust segmentation, identity at scale, GlobalProtect in depth, Prisma Access, Prisma SD-WAN branches, threat prevention tuning, VM-Series and Cloud NGFW, CN-Series, APIs and Terraform, Ansible, log forwarding and SIEM integration, AIOps and best practice assessments, upgrades and exam preparation.
prerequisites: Has configured PAN-OS interfaces, policies, NAT, profiles and VPNs
outcomes: Manage many firewalls with Panorama or Strata Cloud Manager
Design rulebases, segmentation, decryption and identity policy at scale
Secure remote users, branches, clouds and Kubernetes with Palo Alto products
Automate, monitor, upgrade and prepare for the NGFW Engineer exam

days.topic: Panorama: Device Groups, Templates and Template Stacks
days.lab_task: Bring two firewalls under Panorama, build a device group hierarchy and template stack with variables, push shared rules and settings and confirm local overrides.
checks: Both firewalls are connected and in sync
Shared rules and settings reach both firewalls
Template variables give each site its own values

days.topic: Strata Cloud Manager: Cloud Management, Folders and Snippets
subtopics: Strata Cloud Manager for NGFWs and Prisma Access
days.lab_task: Onboard a firewall to Strata Cloud Manager, build folders and a snippet for standard profiles, push it and compare the workflow with Panorama.
checks: The firewall reports to Strata Cloud Manager
The snippet applies the standard profiles
Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager are compared for the course company

days.topic: Rulebase Design at Scale: Structure, Tags and Policy Optimizer
days.lab_task: Restructure a messy 150-rule rulebase into tagged sections with dynamic address groups and external dynamic lists, remove unused rules and record the intent of each section.
checks: Rules are grouped and tagged by section
Unused rules are removed after review
Dynamic groups update without rule changes

days.topic: Advanced Routing: BGP Policies, Redistribution and Policy-Based Forwarding
days.lab_task: Connect two ISPs with BGP and BFD, prefer one with route maps, send one application out the second ISP with policy-based forwarding and test failover.
checks: The chosen application uses the second ISP

days.topic: Decryption at Scale: Certificates, Hardware Security Modules and Exceptions
days.lab_task: Raise decryption coverage across a site with staged rules, handle failing pinned applications with exceptions and report coverage and performance impact.
checks: Decryption coverage rises without user complaints

days.topic: Zero Trust Segmentation with Zones, App-ID and Device-ID
subtopics: Device-ID for IoT and unmanaged devices
days.lab_task: Map flows to a protect surface from logs, write least-privilege rules with App-ID and Device-ID, enforce them in stages and show blocked lateral movement.
checks: Required flows are listed from logs
A lateral movement test is blocked

days.topic: Identity-Based Policy at Scale: Cloud Identity Engine and SAML Authentication
subtopics: SAML authentication for admins and users
Identity for remote and cloud users
days.lab_task: Connect two directories through the Cloud Identity Engine, use SAML for admin login, redistribute mappings to all firewalls and quarantine a user with a dynamic user group.
checks: Users from both directories are mapped everywhere
The tagged user is restricted at once

days.topic: GlobalProtect in Depth: Gateways, HIP Checks and Always-On Access
subtopics: GlobalProtect for Linux and mobile devices
days.lab_task: Add a second gateway with best-gateway selection, internal host detection, pre-logon with machine certificates and HIP-based rules for unmanaged devices.
checks: Clients inside the office skip the tunnel

days.topic: Prisma Access: Mobile Users and Remote Networks
days.lab_task: Onboard mobile users and one remote network to Prisma Access, connect the data centre through a service connection and apply the same policy as on-premises.
checks: Mobile users and the remote network reach the internet through Prisma Access
Users reach data centre apps through the service connection

days.topic: Branch Security with Prisma SD-WAN and ION Devices
subtopics: When to use NGFW or ION at a branch
days.lab_task: Connect a branch with an ION device, steer SaaS traffic through Prisma Access and keep voice on the best path, then compare it with an NGFW-based branch.
checks: The branch comes up through the ION device
SaaS and voice take their chosen paths
ION and NGFW branches are compared

days.topic: Threat Prevention Tuning: Profiles, Exceptions and False Positives
days.lab_task: Review a week of seeded threat logs, tune two noisy signatures with exceptions, tighten server protection and report threat trends.
days.deliverable: Tuned profiles and a threat report
checks: Exceptions remove false positives without opening gaps

days.topic: VM-Series and Cloud NGFW in AWS and Azure
subtopics: Cloud NGFW for AWS and Azure
Transit gateway and virtual WAN hubs
Panorama or Strata Cloud Manager for cloud firewalls
days.lab_task: Deploy Cloud NGFW in front of a cloud application, inspect inbound and outbound traffic, use cloud tags in rules and compare it with a VM-Series design.
days.deliverable: Cloud firewall deployment with a comparison
checks: Inbound and outbound traffic is inspected
Cloud NGFW and VM-Series are compared

days.topic: CN-Series Firewalls for Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Deploy CN-Series on a cluster, inspect traffic between two namespaces, write rules with Kubernetes labels and block a test exploit between pods.
checks: CN-Series runs and reports to Panorama
The test exploit between pods is blocked

days.topic: Automation with the PAN-OS XML API, REST API and Terraform
subtopics: Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager APIs
days.lab_task: Create address objects and a rule through the REST API, manage a rule section with Terraform and commit only after a validation step.
checks: Terraform plans and applies the rule section
Invalid changes are stopped before commit

days.topic: Ansible for PAN-OS Operations
subtopics: The Palo Alto Networks Ansible collection
Software and content upgrades with Ansible
days.lab_task: Write playbooks that back up all firewalls, add a standard rule set and upgrade content, run them twice to show no changes and store secrets safely.
checks: The second run reports no changes
Secrets are stored in a vault

days.topic: Log Forwarding: Syslog, Strata Logging Service and SIEM Integration
days.lab_task: Forward traffic and threat logs to a SIEM in a parsed format, send logs to Strata Logging Service and build a SIEM alert that tags a host for quarantine.
days.deliverable: Log pipeline with an automated response
checks: Logs arrive parsed in the SIEM
Logs arrive in Strata Logging Service
The SIEM alert quarantines the host

days.topic: AIOps for NGFW and Best Practice Assessments
days.lab_task: Run a best practice assessment, act on the top five recommendations, review AIOps health alerts and show the score change.

days.topic: Upgrades and Content Updates: PAN-OS Upgrade Paths and Maintenance Windows
days.lab_task: Plan and run an upgrade of an HA pair through Panorama with a rollback plan, and set a content update schedule with a test delay.
checks: The upgrade path and rollback are written
The HA pair upgrades without an outage
Content updates install after a test delay

days.topic: NGFW Engineer Certification Preparation
subtopics: The NGFW Engineer exam and its domains
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice set for the NGFW Engineer exam, map every miss to a course day and repeat the weakest lab tasks.
checks: A timed practice set is completed
Each miss is mapped to a course day
The weakest lab tasks are repeated
objectives: Prepare for the NGFW Engineer exam

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Centrally Managed Firewall Estate with Remote Access
subtopics: Panorama or Strata Cloud Manager design
days.lab_task: Deliver a centrally managed estate for a head office, two branches and a cloud application with shared policy, segmentation, decryption, remote access, automation, SIEM logging and a tested upgrade.
checks: All firewalls get policy from the central manager
Segmentation and decryption work on every site
Automation, logging and the upgrade are tested

advanced.summary: For network security architects and senior engineers. Covers network security architecture, multi-vsys designs, data centre segmentation, high availability at scale, SASE architecture with Prisma Access, cloud network security at scale, decryption strategy, advanced threat protection, firewall migrations, rulebase lifecycle programmes, policy as code pipelines, performance engineering, compliance, incident response with Cortex, OT and IoT security, securing AI traffic, firewall disaster recovery, the operating model and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Runs Palo Alto firewalls across several sites in production
Holds the NGFW Engineer certification or has equivalent experience
Responsible for network security design or operations
outcomes: Design network security architectures across data centres, branches, clouds and SASE
Run migrations, rulebase programmes and policy as code
Engineer performance, compliance and incident response with firewall data
Secure OT, IoT and AI traffic and lead firewall operations

days.topic: Network Security Architecture: Perimeter, Data Centre, Cloud and SASE Placement
days.lab_task: Design the network security architecture for a company with two data centres, forty branches, two clouds and remote users, and defend it in a review.
days.deliverable: Network security architecture and review record
checks: Firewalls and SASE cover every traffic path
The review accepts the design with actions

days.topic: Multi-Vsys and Multi-Tenant Firewall Designs
days.lab_task: Split a firewall into virtual systems for two business units with their own admins and logs, route between them through a shared gateway and test isolation.
checks: Each unit manages only its virtual system
Units cannot see each other's logs

days.topic: Data Centre Segmentation and East-West Inspection
subtopics: Segmentation with VLANs, VRFs and zones
days.lab_task: Design east-west inspection for a leaf-spine data centre, insert firewalls for three application tiers and prove that only allowed flows pass.
days.deliverable: Data centre segmentation design and test results

days.topic: High Availability at Scale: Active/Active, Clusters and HA Troubleshooting
days.lab_task: Build an active/active pair with floating addresses, handle asymmetric traffic, test five failure scenarios and fix a seeded HA sync problem.
checks: All five failure scenarios behave as designed

days.topic: SASE Architecture with Prisma Access
subtopics: Prisma Access for users, branches and private apps
days.lab_task: Design SASE for the company with ZTNA for private apps, cloud SWG for users, branch onboarding and experience monitoring, and plan the migration from on-premises edges.
checks: Users, branches and private apps are covered
The migration plan has waves and rollback

days.topic: Cloud Network Security at Scale: Transit Designs and Auto Scaling
subtopics: Transit gateway and virtual WAN designs
days.lab_task: Design centralised inspection for ten cloud accounts with auto scaling, use cloud tags in policy and compare cost with distributed Cloud NGFW.
days.deliverable: Cloud inspection design with cost comparison

days.topic: Decryption Strategy: Privacy, Legal and Performance Trade-Offs
days.lab_task: Write a decryption strategy with privacy rules, exclusions and capacity planning, review it with legal and HR personas and plan its rollout.
checks: Legal and HR approve the approach

days.topic: Advanced Threat Protection: Inline Machine Learning, Zero-Day Prevention and Threat Hunting
days.lab_task: Hunt for a seeded intrusion in firewall logs, block its indicators with external dynamic lists and show inline machine learning stopping a new variant.
checks: The intrusion is found in logs
The new variant is blocked inline

days.topic: Firewall Migration: Moving from Check Point, Cisco or Fortinet to PAN-OS
days.lab_task: Convert a seeded Check Point or Cisco rulebase, test it in parallel, plan the cutover with rollback and turn ten rules into App-ID rules after migration.
checks: Converted rules match the old behaviour
The cutover plan has rollback steps
Ten rules use App-ID after migration

days.topic: Rulebase Lifecycle Programmes: Requests, Reviews and Clean-Up
days.lab_task: Set up a rule request process with owners and expiry, review a large seeded rulebase for shadowed and permissive rules and report health metrics.
days.deliverable: Rule lifecycle process and health report
checks: New rules need an owner and expiry
Shadowed and permissive rules are fixed

days.topic: Network Security Automation Pipelines: Policy as Code and Change Validation
subtopics: Pipelines that push through Panorama or Strata Cloud Manager
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline where rule changes come as pull requests, are tested, approved and pushed, detect drift from manual changes and roll back a bad change.
days.deliverable: Policy pipeline with tests and a rollback
checks: Manual changes are reported as drift
A bad change is reverted from Git

days.topic: Performance Engineering: Sizing, Session Capacity and Throughput Testing
subtopics: Throughput with threat prevention and decryption
Data sheets compared with real traffic
days.lab_task: Size firewalls for a data centre from traffic data, load-test a lab firewall with threat prevention and decryption, find the bottleneck and write a capacity report.

days.topic: Compliance and Audits: PCI DSS, Assessment Reports and Evidence
subtopics: Network security controls in PCI DSS 4.0
days.lab_task: Prove card data segmentation, collect change and log evidence for a PCI DSS audit and remediate two seeded findings.
checks: Segmentation tests show card data isolation

days.topic: Incident Response with Firewall Data and Cortex Integration
tools: Cortex XSIAM or another SOC platform
days.lab_task: Investigate a seeded compromise with firewall logs in the SOC platform, contain the host automatically, preserve evidence and update rules after the incident.
days.deliverable: Incident record with containment and rule updates
checks: The attack path is reconstructed from logs
Rules are updated to stop a repeat

days.topic: OT and IoT Security with Device-ID and Industrial Protocols
subtopics: Industrial protocols such as Modbus and DNP3 in App-ID
days.lab_task: Profile devices on a seeded OT network, write rules that allow only required industrial commands and alert on an unexpected write command.
checks: The unexpected write command raises an alert

days.topic: Securing AI Traffic: Controls for Generative AI Apps and AI Runtime Security
subtopics: Risks of AI apps in the enterprise
Controlling generative AI apps with App-ID and AI Access Security
AI runtime security for internal AI applications
days.lab_task: Discover AI app use from logs, allow approved tools with DLP on prompts, block unapproved tools and protect an internal AI app from a seeded prompt injection.
checks: AI app use is reported by user group
Unapproved tools are blocked and prompts are scanned
The prompt injection against the internal app is stopped

days.topic: Disaster Recovery and Configuration Management for Firewalls
subtopics: Licences and serial numbers in recovery
days.lab_task: Back up firewall and Panorama configuration to version control, rebuild a failed firewall from backup and measure recovery time.
checks: The firewall is rebuilt from backup
Recovery time is measured against the target

days.topic: Firewall Operating Model: Change Management, Rule Requests and Team Roles
days.lab_task: Design the firewall operating model with roles, change rules, request service levels and on-call, and report a seeded month of service data.
checks: Roles and change rules are defined

days.topic: Troubleshooting at Scale: Packet Flow, Counters and Support Cases
subtopics: Data plane and management plane resources
days.lab_task: Diagnose seeded problems on a large estate, a data plane drop, a failed push and a log collector backlog, fix them, open one support case and write a review.
checks: Each problem's cause is shown with evidence
The support case has all needed data

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Network Security Design with NGFW and SASE
subtopics: Architecture across sites, clouds and SASE
days.lab_task: Present an enterprise network security design to a review board with the architecture, segmentation and decryption strategy, SASE plan, policy pipeline, compliance evidence, migration plan and operating model.
days.deliverable: Design with evidence and a board decision
checks: Segmentation and recovery claims have test evidence
Migration and operations plans have owners
